title: Spa Bali Moon: pilih dunia visual
question: Palette (Warm Ivory, Soft Sand, Taupe, Sage, Deep Olive, Warm Brown) dan font (serif editorial + Manrope) sudah dikunci brief. Yang dipilih di sini adalah cara dunia itu diekspresikan. Pertahankan hasil roll, ambil alternatif, atau re-roll.

options.label: The Moon Calendar
options.lineage: Balinese lunar calendar: purnama (full moon) and tilem (new moon) as the island's measure of time
options.thesis: Time at the spa told in moon phases: every duration reads as a crescent that waxes to full.
options.viewport: Tall original treatment photo on one side; 'Our Seminyak Day Spa' in large editorial serif; the WhatsApp booking button; beneath it a slim moon rail (30 min crescent → 2 h full) that previews how durations read across the site.
options.risk: The moon turns kitsch or new-age if it is used as decoration instead of as the working duration scale.

raised.raise: The duration scale is one unbroken rail, identical on every page and price card, scaled but never wrapped.
Two inks carry the page: olive ink on ivory. Taupe exists only as moon fill, sage only as selected state.
Text sits in horizontal courses: one baseline rhythm for price rows and headings, measure matched to content.

options.label: The Reception Menu Card
options.lineage: the printed treatment menu handed over at a Bali spa reception
options.thesis: The whole site set like the treatment menu you are handed on arrival.
options.viewport: Full-height treatment photo with a menu card laid over its edge, listing signature treatments with dot-leader prices and a WhatsApp button at the foot of the card.
options.risk: Familiar: this is where most spa redesigns land.

options.label: Drum Machine Step Row
options.thesis: Booking as punching steps into a running pattern.
options.viewport: Sixteen step keys as treatment slots under a chase light.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a spa guest does not identify with a sequencer; neon keys break the pinned palette.
options.risk: Reads as a music toy, not a spa.
options.kept: One unbroken line: the duration rail never wraps.

options.label: ASCII Live Scene
options.thesis: Spa scenes rendered as glyph density.
options.viewport: A glyph-rendered massage scene with captions in the grid.
options.case: Fuses poorly: cold and technical; loses both identification and clarity.
options.risk: Hostile to the calm the brand promises.
options.kept: One strict grid governs every page.

options.label: Noir One-Sheet Duotone
options.thesis: Two inks and a long cast shadow.
options.viewport: A small figure throwing a huge shadow under a condensed title.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dramatic and dark where the brief asks for light and calm.
options.kept: Total two-ink commitment: olive on ivory, nothing sprinkled.

options.label: Torn Billboard Décollage
options.thesis: Layers torn back to reveal older campaigns.
options.viewport: Ragged tears exposing fragments of old treatment posters.
options.case: Fuses poorly: chaotic layering fights price clarity.
options.kept: Depth as history: 'Since 2009' earns a real place, not a badge.

options.label: Rain-Night Cityscape
options.thesis: The city passing from dusk to dawn.
options.viewport: Skyline bands with amber transit lines.
options.case: Fuses poorly: urban and dark; Seminyak guests come to slow down.
options.kept: Time-of-day awareness, once the owner confirms the opening hours.

options.label: Coiled Earth Tower
options.case: Fuses partly: organic and handmade, but terracotta overrides the pinned palette and slab caps hurt reading.
options.kept: Horizontal courses: one baseline rhythm for every row.

canonCard.label: Luxury spa editorial (category standard)
canonCard.thesis: What every Bali spa site ships, executed with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Full-bleed photo hero, centered serif headline, two buttons, then a grid of treatment cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
